meta.name: li-profile
meta.description: Score a LinkedIn profile out of 100 against a 12-part rubric and rewrite the parts that lose points - headline, about, experience, featured, banner. Use when the user says "optimize my profile", "score my LinkedIn", "rewrite my headline", "fix my about section", or pastes their profile and asks how it reads.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按评分表诊断并改写领英档案,让招聘方和客户一眼看懂你的价值
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在找工作或拓展客户,想让领英主页更有说服力
copy.tagline_en: Rewrite your LinkedIn profile to make recruiters and clients see your value at a glance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're job hunting or winning clients and want a sharper LinkedIn profile

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 12 项标准给你的 LinkedIn 主页打分（满分 100），并把丢分部分——标题、关于、经历、精选、横幅——改写成可直接粘贴的文本，最后重新打分。它不会代你登录。
howto.when: 当你说“优化我的主页”、“给 LinkedIn 打分”、“改写我的标题”等，或粘贴主页内容问它读起来怎么样时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 LinkedIn 主页打分
say.note: 先出评分表，再按丢分顺序改写

say.text: 把我的标题改写一下，给我三个选项
say.note: 标题丢分最多时先改它

say.text: 这是我主页顶部卡片的截图，看看读起来怎么样

howto.what_en: After install, Claude scores your LinkedIn profile out of 100 against a 12-part rubric, then rewrites losing parts — headline, about, experience, featured, banner — as copy-ready text and re-scores. Nothing is saved to LinkedIn.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “optimize my profile”, “score my LinkedIn”, “rewrite my headline”, etc., or paste your profile and ask how it reads.

say_en.note: Shows the score table first, then rewrites

say_en.text: Rewrite my headline and give me three options
say_en.note: Headline is fixed first when it loses most points

say_en.text: Here's a screenshot of my top card — how does it read?
say_en.note: A screenshot is enough for the first pass
